purpose: Class-aligned high support vs exact-ring lowest support low-level characterization
mode: EXPLORATORY Eval8000 (same repeatedly inspected test images); NOT pixel-level artifact localization accuracy

definition.percentile: exact original within-image np.argsort rank / 195; each metric computed from RGB resized 224x224
definition.red_fake: frozen strict-pair own Top10 highest fake-support patch scores
definition.red_real: 10 lowest fake-support patch scores, i.e. highest -fake-score (real-aligned) patches
definition.blue: lowest class-aligned score patches disjoint from red with identical B1/B2-only/interior counts
definition.caveat: Original v2 script computes 5-metric composite including FFT; Detail4 is an explicitly separate 4-metric projection

bootstrap.method: same-image paired within-source; fixed generator sources; real images sampled uniquely once
